metadata.datasource: Kodak publication H-1-5222 (EASTMAN DOUBLE-X Negative Film 5222 / 7222, March 2022), p3: spectral sensitivity and sensitometric curves, raster images in the PDF traced at 600 dpi (each curve followed from a seed point).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 401-646 nm: the D = 0.3 above gross fog curve (the upper one); ASSUMED held below 401 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0401 dex/nm above 646 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.49..1.10 (D-96, 21 C, 6 1/2 min (gamma 0.66, the plotted curve nearest the recommended control gamma 0.65); densitometry Status M blue: the one curve the sheet plots; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.650); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.576 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 250 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/250)+1.0 = -1.495 log lux-s
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0431 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
